product.name: Apple 60W MagSafe 2 Charger
product.full_name: Genuine 60W MagSafe 2 Power Adapter for MacBook Pro Retina 13"
product.description: Genuine Apple power adapter (Model A1435, Apple Part No. MD565LL/A) for MacBook Pro with Retina display 13-inch (Late 2012 to Early 2015, A1425 / A1502). Uses the thin, magnetic MagSafe 2 connector — not compatible with older MagSafe 1 (L-shaped / T-shaped) MacBooks. 16.5V, 3.65A, 60W output. It can also safely charge MacBook Air models with MagSafe 2 (2012-2017), which only draw what they need. Not suitable for the 15-inch MacBook Pro Retina, which needs the 85W adapter. Includes the detachable AC wall plug. Wide-range 100–240V AC input for worldwide use. Original Apple unit, tested before dispatch.
